shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,240p' package.json && sed -n '1,240p' next.config.ts && sed -n '1,260p' app/layout.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,320p' app/ProductGrid.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/ProductSkeleton.tsx && sed -n '1,320p' 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' && sed -n '1,360p' app/globals.css && sed -n '1,320p' lib/products.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "npm ls next react react-dom --depth=0 && sed -n '1,240p' tsconfig.json && rg -n \"interface ViewTransition|type ViewTransition|function ViewTransition|transitionTypes\" node_modules/@types/react node_modules/next/types node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,240p'"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts && rg -n \"canary\" node_modules/next/dist -g '*.js' | rg 'next-env|reference types' | sed -n '1,160p'"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- next.config.ts app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- tsconfig.json && git status --short && sed -n '1,120p' tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc 'for browser in chromium chromium-browser google-chrome google-chrome-stable; do command -v "$browser" && "$browser" --version; done; npm ls @playwright/test playwright puppeteer --depth=0 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json AGENTS.md next.config.ts && test -f next-env.d.ts && sed -n '1,80p' next-env.d.ts || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'find .next -type f -delete && find .next -type l -delete && find .next -depth -type d -empty -delete && git status --short && git diff --check'
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba next.config.ts && nl -ba app/page.tsx && nl -ba app/ProductGrid.tsx && nl -ba 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' && nl -ba app/globals.css | sed -n '1,300p'"
